objective: Check whether a caller can report a completed gate without running the required fingerprint comparison.
mandatory_requirements: A returned material artifact must be compared with the complete effective research fingerprint before acceptance.
A non-zero fingerprint result must remain a stop signal.
definition_of_done: The observed bypass is either confirmed with evidence or explicitly unresolved.
One bounded correction or a clear blocker is recorded.
The affected requirement has a named regression check.
observed_signal: The caller supplied a schema-valid COMPLETE artifact reference but no recorded fingerprint-check result or exit code.

finding.summary: The current caller-enforced path can appear complete while the fingerprint comparison was skipped.
finding.protected_intent: Prevent an unreviewed research-definition or result change from becoming effective.
finding.risk: A valid-looking artifact could create false confidence and allow silent research drift.

corrective_action.summary: Keep the affected transition blocked until the comparison result and candidate fingerprint are recorded.
corrective_action.scope: The current transition only; do not redesign the broader orchestration during this review.
corrective_action.exit_condition: The exact baseline and candidate have been compared and the non-zero/unchanged result is recorded.

regression.requirement: A missing fingerprint-check record cannot be accepted as a completed material step.
regression.method: Run the caller-bypass evaluation case with the comparison result omitted and require a blocked disposition.

unsupported_claims: This review does not prove that every live agent skips the comparison.
This review does not establish a market effect or trading edge.
